_comment: Cookie Run BOX-FARM run-grind, EPISODE 5 — plays runs to the end (till death) collecting Mystery Boxes passively; NO boost purchase, Fast Start ONLY. PRECONDITION: Episode 5 selected on home BEFORE starting (bot only taps Play!). Fast Start is spammed (985,515) after leaving home — on the shop path from check_heart after its Play tap, on the direct-run path from await_shop absent. Boxes collected mid-run open on the Mystery Box screen after Result. Loop: home->Play->await_shop->(shop->check_heart | direct->spam)->check_heart(Play+FastStart spam)->run(NO jump/slide; QUIT at 2nd box via check_box->quit_run, else die)->run_result->mystery_box->reveal->home. home Play coord may differ from ep6 (1650) — verify live for Episode 5.

home._note: Main menu, detected by the episode-independent 'Play!' button (home_play_marker.png — see coinrun.json for why the old Episode-banner marker silently broke). Play! visible = nothing covers it, tap it. Absent -> a modal covers it or we're elsewhere: hand off to probe_sendlife (NEVER blind-tap from here). 3000ms wait covers the boost-shop fade-in before await_shop re-checks. Play! at (1650,970). Play! at (1650,970) -> await_shop. No home-spam and no after_play gate: after_play misread the Play! button showing THROUGH the shop fade (~0.87) as a missed tap and double-tapped Play, which closed the shop. Fast Start is spammed later (await_shop absent = direct run, or check_heart = shop path) — always AFTER we have left home, so it can never hit the leaderboard.

pre_play._note: Between home and the Play tap: a "Send <name> a free Life?" dialog can sit ON TOP of home while Play! still scores 1.00 underneath — tapping Play then just hits the dialog and the run never starts. Detect the dialog (sendlife_marker) and Cancel it (727,688), back to home to re-check. Clear -> tap Play (1650,970) and proceed to await_shop.

await_shop._note: After Play, poll for the boost shop. ep5 buys NOTHING (Fast Start only), so shop present -> check_heart directly. Absent after retries = direct run (Play went straight in) -> spam the Fast Start spot (985,515) across the prompt window (safe: off home) -> running. NO-BUY GUARD: the Fast Start spam (985,515) only fires on the direct-run branch (await_shop ABSENT = no shop on screen), never while the shop is up — so it can never land on the HP-potion (~340,875) or Timepiece/clock (~570,875) boost tiles the user forbids buying. When the shop IS present we go straight to check_heart and tap only Play (1365,931), far from those tiles.

probe_dailycheckin._note: New head of the modal-peeling chain. The 'Daily Check-in' calendar pops ONCE per day at first launch and sits ON TOP of home, hiding Play! — with no dismiss the whole bot stalls here (observed live: run loop never resumed). Detected by the unique 'Daily Check-in' banner title (dailycheckin_marker: self=1.000, in-run frame=0.232 — no false-positive). Present -> tap the green OK button (965,985, CV-located from the button's green blob) -> home re-checks. Absent -> fall to probe_sendlife, the rest of the chain unchanged.

probe_treasurereward._note: The 'Power+ Treasure Rewards' popup stacks right after Daily Check-in at launch (Choco Dip Sticks / Crystal Crown etc.), also covering Play!. Same stall class as the check-in: no dismiss -> bot loses home. Detected by the unique 'Power+ Treasure Rewards' title (marker self=1.000, in-run=0.31, vs dailycheckin=0.40 — no cross-match). Present -> tap Confirm (960,850) -> home. Absent -> fall to probe_sendlife. Reached from BOTH the check-in dismiss (popups queue) and directly when only this one shows.

probe_sendlife._note: Reached whenever Play! is not visible and no Daily Check-in popup was on screen. 'Send <friend> a free Life?' dialog pops over home when a stray tap lands on a leaderboard friend row. Tap Cancel (727,688 — gray, left); NEVER Confirm (1189,687). Detected by the unique 'Gift Points' text. Dismissed -> home. Absent -> try the boost shop next.

boost_shop._note: Boost shop open (entry point for guard/probe re-routing). Route to probe_magnet to ensure Magnetic Aura is equipped before Play.

check_heart._note: SINGLE Play gate. heart_empty present -> wait 30s self-loop until a heart regenerates. Absent (>=1 heart) -> tap Play, then SPAM-TAP the Fast Start button spot (985,515) every ~400ms from the load screen through the whole prompt window and into the run. Blind spam instead of detect+tap: the prompt appears ~5.6s after Play and lingers only ~2s, so a fixed cadence of taps across 0-8s can never miss it, and taps that land before/after the prompt are harmless (empty run area). Ends at running. Its Play tap is (1365,931) and the Fast Start spam is (985,515) — both well clear of the HP-potion (~340,875) and clock (~570,875) boost tiles, so the run is never charged for a boost. NEVER add taps in the 250-680 x / 800-960 y zone here.

running._note: In-run (auto-play). Result popup up -> run over. Not up -> we MIGHT still be running, but could equally be on home or in the shop, so DON'T tap yet: hand off to the guard chain.

guard_not_home._note: Guard 1/2 before any in-run tap: Play! on screen -> we're on home, not running.

guard_not_shop._note: Guard 2/2: shop -> boost_shop. Mid-run -> check_box to see if we have 2 boxes yet. ep5 does NOT jump/slide/relay (user requirement) — but it DOES quit early once the box counter reads x2, so a run ends the moment the 2nd box is collected instead of waiting for death.

guard_not_sendlife._note: Guard 3: a "Send <name> a free Life?" dialog can pop mid-loop when a Play/Fast-Start tap grazes a leaderboard friend row (we are actually still on the Friends-tab home, not in a run). Detect it (sendlife_marker) and Cancel (727,688 — gray/left, NEVER Confirm 1189,687) then back to home. Absent -> genuinely mid-run -> check_box. Without this the dialog hung the bot (the mid-run guard chain never routes through the home popup-peel chain).

guard_not_levelup._note: Guard 4: a "Level Up" reward popup (levelup_marker, self=1.000) can pop mid-loop when the cookie gains enough XP during a run — same class of bug as Send-Life: it sits on top of whatever screen is under it and the mid-run guard chain would otherwise never route through the home popup-peel chain to dismiss it. Confirm (959,969, same coord as probe_levelup) -> home. Absent -> genuinely mid-run -> check_box.

check_shop_after_run._note: Result popup not up yet — still running, home is back, or we're in the shop. Try home; absent -> walk the probe chain.

probe_boostshop._note: Recovery probe: sitting in the boost shop (process started there, or run ended straight into shop)? boost_shop routes to probe_speed.

probe_congrats._note: Level-up 'Congratulations!' popup (free reward). Confirm (956,846) is safe/free.

probe_levelup._note: Separate 'Level Up' popup (gems/coins/score-bonus, distinct from the Congratulations ticket popup). Confirm (959,969) is safe/free.

probe_rankingrewards._note: SAFETY NET: gold 'Ranking Rewards' season popup opened by a stray leaderboard tap. X at (1672,135), free/safe.

probe_giftdraw._note: SAFETY NET: 'Gift Draw' popup over home. Tap X (1685,170) — never Draw; the farm loop must not auto-consume gift draws.

probe_friendinfo._note: SAFETY NET: 'Friend's ___' popup family (can stack 2 layers). Tap inner X (1552,117) then outer X (1633,107) each pass, self-loop until the ribbon is gone.

run_result._note: Result popup after a run. Tap OK (702,940) — NOT 'Show Off'. After OK the Mystery Box screen appears on runs that collected a '?' box — the whole point of this bot — handled by mystery_box.

mystery_box._note: After Result-OK we either land on home, or the 'Mystery Box' screen blocks it. Detect the BOX screen positively. Present -> tap the closed box (960,540) and read the reward. Absent -> home (or a modal; home's probe chain handles it).

mystery_box_recheck._note: After collecting the box: Play! visible -> home is clear, continue the loop. Not visible -> something still covers it; go through probe_sendlife, never blind-tap.

check_box._note: STAGE 1 of the quit gate: is the Mystery Box counter even on screen? boxcounter_marker is the wooden "?" box icon (present for x1, x2, ... — CV: present ~0.9+, absent ~0.35). Absent -> no box collected yet -> running (never quit). Present -> check_box2 reads the digit. This guards against the x2-only crop false-matching jelly/coin noise mid-run and quitting with zero boxes (seen live).

check_box2._note: STAGE 2: the box counter IS on screen (check_box confirmed) — does it read x2? boxcount2_marker (x2-only digit crop). Present -> quit_run (2 boxes, bail). Absent -> only 1 box so far -> running to keep polling. Because we only reach here with a real counter on screen, a stray jelly/coin can no longer trigger a false quit. THRESHOLD 0.95 (not the global 0.82): the small x2 digit crop can score ~0.85 on an x1 counter (the 1 and 2 share strokes), which false-quit at 1 box live. x2 self-matches at 1.00, so 0.95 clears x1 while still catching a real x2.

quit_run._note: 2 boxes collected -> bail via the pause menu. pause (1790,55) -> menu Quit (960,640) -> confirm Quit (960,570, NOT Cancel 960,755) -> Result with both boxes credited -> run_result opens/reveals them. Generous waits (1200-2500ms) for each menu/dialog fade. Coords reused from boxrun_ep6.

probe_inactive._note: Home-side inactive guard. 'You've been inactive for a while. The game will restart!' can queue on/over home after a long idle. Confirm (953,690) lets the restart proceed, then hand to recover_login to re-auth. Absent -> probe_prevresults.

probe_prevresults._note: 'Previous Results / You have unreviewed game results' pops after a run that was cut short (e.g. by the inactive-restart). Confirm (950,680) opens the Result screen, then fall through to the normal chain which peels Result/MysteryBox/Congrats. Absent -> probe_dailycheckin (chain unchanged).

guard_not_inactive._note: Mid-run inactive guard. The inactive-restart popup can fire WHILE a run is on screen (Jump/Slide visible) when the bot stops feeding input -> observed live hanging the run. Confirm (953,690) -> recover_login re-auths. Absent -> the run is genuinely live: fall through to the original mid-run action (unchanged).

recover_login._note: Login recovery step 1 (DevPlay title). After the inactive-restart the game reopens on the DevPlay title with the orange 'DevPlay Login' button (devplaylogin_marker, self=1.0). Present -> tap it (960,950) to open the account picker, wait for the fade, hand to recover_pick. Absent -> we may already be at the picker (or past login) -> recover_pick.

verify_no_popup._note: Play-tap gate. The 'You've been inactive -> restart' popup overlays home/shop while Play! still scores ~0.87 through it, so home.on_match would tap Play INTO the popup and spin. Check inactive_marker first: present -> Confirm (953,690) -> recover_login re-auths. Absent -> no popup, run the real Play tap (original home.on_match body).

recover_pick._note: Login recovery step 2 (account picker). login_marker = 'You already have an account!' + CookieRun logo (name-agnostic). Present -> tap the top saved account row (1100,490), wait out the ~12s login + home load, re-enter start_state (home). Absent -> the picker isn't up (login already completed, or the title is still animating) -> go to start_state and let its own detection settle; if we're still on the title, home will be absent and the probe chain loops us back to recover_login.

verify_no_sendlife._note: Second Play-tap gate. A 'Send <name> a free Life?' dialog can sit ON TOP of home (or the boost shop) while Play! still scores 1.00 through it, same class of bug as the inactive-popup gate. Present -> Cancel (727,688 — gray/left, NEVER Confirm 1189,687) -> back to home to re-check. Absent -> no popup at all -> run the real Play tap (original verify_no_popup.on_absent body, unchanged).

probe_settings._note: User can manually open Game Settings (gear icon, top-right of home) at any time, on any tab (Options/Notifications/Performance/Game Info) -- no marker recognized this screen before, so the bot sat frozen matching nothing. Detect the teal 'Game Settings' title ribbon (shared by all 4 tabs); close via X (1671,145) -> home re-checks. Absent -> continue the normal chain.

probe_fortunebakery._note: 'Fortune Bakery' popup (fortune-cookie dough picker) can sit over home, covering Play!, with no auto-buy risk on our side (we never tap Select Dough). Detected by the teal 'Fortune Bakery' banner (fortunebakery_marker.png). Close via X (1633,301 — scaled from a 1217x703 screenshot ratio, NOT yet CV-verified live; re-crop/re-measure on first live catch if the tap misses). Absent -> probe_prevresults (chain unchanged).

mb_open._note: Mystery Box screen — one self-looping dismiss state (replaces the mb_gate/mystery_box_reveal/mb_reveal_gate/mb_reveal_retry_2..6 chain, which claimed to cap at 6 dual-taps but retry_2 looped straight back to mystery_box_reveal so _3.._6 were dead and the loop was unbounded; mb_gate/mb_reveal_gate also detected inactive_marker while their notes described the Mystery Box screen). Each pass taps Open-all (960,965), box-center (960,540) and per-item Confirm (959,960) — covers both known layouts, a tap that hits nothing is harmless. Marker gone -> mystery_box_recheck. match_timeout_ms is the REAL bound on a stuck MATCH (timeout_ms only fires on the absent path). An inactive popup here covers the marker -> absent path -> recheck -> home's probe chain reaches recover_login, so the per-pass inactive check the old gates did is redundant.
